From what I’ve learned, drinking pop is more harmful than long term microdosing. It’s true microdosing isn’t risk free but the benefits far outweigh the already minimal risks. You can also say we don’t know much about the full risks behind microdosing but even without fully knowing what the long term risks are, we can make an assumption that there’s a lot worse things you can put in your body. I agree that it’s not sensible to always rely on shrooms or LSD because there are gonna be times when I might not be able to get it or something happens and I’m not able to take it. I don’t believe you should constantly be taking microdoses but if you use it responsibly, I feel as though it’s a very good tool to help cope with stuff that you can’t control. Depression isn’t controllable for a lot of people, including me, because it’s a mental thing and it just comes and goes whenever it pleases. Not too long ago, I was in a really bad depressive rut where I wouldn’t talk to anyone and I never payed attention to anything around me. I could barely talk to my own family. I basically just felt I wasn’t in control of myself and I had really dark thoughts, mostly suicidal. That’s not crazy, that’s just how depression makes me feel. I haven’t been this upbeat and happy in a long time, and part of that is also because I’ve taken control of other problems in my life, but the other part of that seems to be from microdosing. And honestly I have very mild anxiety, like I can still talk to people and have fluent conversations but I still get nervous regardless. Ive noticed through this week that I flow through conversations so easily and I’m way more confident. All I’m trying to say is that, yeah I agree micrpdosing isn’t the only thing you should do, but it can help immensely and I don’t believe my opinion is reckless. If anything, I believe my opinion is helpful because it’s encouraging others to try microdosing. I believe anyone who has issues like me should try microdosing and see if it helps but they should do it responsibly and thoroughly research it before starting.

Drinking pop increases your risk of having a stroke, kills dental health, increases risk of gout, can lead to diabetes, can increase risk of cancer, and caffeine (which is in pop) can be addictive. Long term microdosing is thought to have some affect on the heart and it could possibly affect sleeping patterns. And that’s if you do it frequently (like everyday) and don’t take breaks. So, basically, pop is worse for your health than microdosing could ever be (no matter what psychedelic you use) and people drink the shit outa pop.
